**Sundhedsklynge Lillebælt** is a healthcare cluster (sundhedsklynge) operating within [[region-syddanmark|Region Syddanmark]] in Denmark. It is actively monitored in the national quality reports for [[atrieflimren]] (AFDK) published by the Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram (RKKP) and the Danish Healthcare Quality Institute. The cluster plays a significant role in the regional and national tracking of cardiovascular care quality, specifically concerning the diagnosis, treatment, and clinical outcomes of atrial fibrillation patients.

In the 2023/24 reporting period, Sundhedsklynge Lillebælt demonstrated strong performance in several key clinical quality indicators. Notably, it fulfilled the standard for Indikator 1, which measures the timely initiation of anticoagulation therapy in newly diagnosed patients, achieving a result of 91.3% [^src1]. Furthermore, the cluster recorded the highest proportion of echocardiography execution ([[indikator-2|Indikator 2]]) among all clusters, reaching 89.4% (95% CI: 87.4–91.2) [^src2]. It also successfully met the standard for [[indikator-4b|Indikator 4b]], which tracks the annual measurement of P-creatinine in patients on DOAC treatment [^src5]. 

Beyond diagnostic and treatment initiation metrics, the cluster's data is integral to understanding the broader epidemiological and clinical outcomes of atrial fibrillation in Denmark. It is included in national geographic distributions mapping the incidence of ischemic stroke ([[indikator-5|Indikator 5]]) across various healthcare clusters [^src5]. The cluster's performance is consistently evaluated across multiple indicators, including treatment coverage over 1-year, 2-year, and 5-year periods [^src3], severe bleeding incidents [^src7], heart failure development [^src8], and mortality rates [^src6]. While it excels in certain areas, such as echocardiography and initial anticoagulation, it faces challenges in other metrics, such as structured patient education and certain long-term treatment coverage thresholds, where it occasionally falls below the standard fulfillment mark [^src3], [^src4], [^src10].

The continuous inclusion of Sundhedsklynge Lillebælt in both the 2024 [^src1] and 2025 [^src9] AFDK reports underscores its ongoing relevance in the Danish healthcare quality infrastructure. Its data, derived from national registries like the Landspatientregisteret and Lægemiddelstatistikregisteret, provides critical insights for regional benchmarking and clinical governance in [[region-syddanmark|Region Syddanmark]].
